title: Trusted declarative Build activities and accessible preview
whatBuilt: Versioned, server-registered allowlisted activity schemas (components + approved trusted renderers + bounds); clients cannot extend

Manifest admission = validation, never execution: component/renderer allowlist, bounded depth/size, banned-content scan (scripts, arbitrary HTML, unsafe URL, network action, hidden answer key) before anything persists; arrays recursed too

Trusted accessible preview over a FIXED immutable proposal base revision: digest re-verified; only the approved renderer's safe plain-text view rows are returned (never raw script/HTML from the manifest); no generated JS/HTML executed anywhere
Distinct authorized operations: generation/admit, preview, accept (apply-as-new-revision), export — each ownership-guarded; sharing stays in the KAN-80 contract
Stale proposals (base moved) and cancelled runs fail closed; accept idempotent per decision; export re-verifies integrity and fails closed on tampered bytes
This does NOT enable the separate arbitrary-code/public-app runtime

provenEndToEnd.admissionPlusPreview: valid allowlisted manifest binds to exact committed base revision; preview serves fixed base, approved renderer, safe plain-text rows only
provenEndToEnd.malformed: unknown component, unapproved renderer, unknown schema rejected before admit
provenEndToEnd.injection: <script>, javascript:, http(s)://, fetch()/network, hidden answer key (top-level and nested) all block admit
provenEndToEnd.cancelledRun: a proposal whose run is cancelled is never admitted
provenEndToEnd.staleProposal: new edit moves the base; accept blocked base_revision_moved while preview stays on the fixed revision
provenEndToEnd.crossDeviceResume: second device previews the same fixed revision and accepts once; replay idempotent (duplicate, no double-append); reject records without history; export digest-verified
provenEndToEnd.wrongUserAndIntegrity: wrong user denied preview/accept/export; tampered base bytes fail preview AND export closed

verification.declarativeactivityCheck: npm run declarativeactivity:check -> 8/8 tests pass (compile tsconfig.declarativeactivity.json + node --test)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
notes: Prereqs per ticket: KAN-75, KAN-78, KAN-150, KAN-58 (this lane bases on the Build chain and composes runs/projects/sharing; KAN-150 AI-16 scene protocol and KAN-58 FILE-03 download/export are separate contracts this module composes for the fixed-revision + export paths). Hosted/provider/load/privacy/commercial/educational gates remain open; no such gate is claimed closed by this work.
